metadata.description: The sharaqi conductor: plan with Opus, build with Haiku and Sonnet, review with Opus, and see the tokens saved.

plugins.name: sharaqi
plugins.description: /sharaqi do <task>: Opus plans at medium or high by task clarity, cheaper models build each card (Sonnet never above medium), a diff-sized reviewer checks spec, quality and security, capped at Opus 5.5 high, with a savings report against all-Opus-medium.
